name: Hidaka Takeshi
source:
He is Arisa's husband and a freelance designer. Although he is a freelance designer, he only works on Arisa's company's website and other small jobs. 

He is an all-around good househusband, but he is very lenient with his daughters, which has caused them to grow up to be a bit selfish, which is a recent problem for him. 

While he is enjoying his hobby of fishing on this trip, his beloved wife and children are being corrupted. 

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/kk/character.html#Chara07]Official website[/url]]
